x-poly-enum-descriptions.AHEAD: Available in the environment while its release is still pending there.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PENDING: Not yet available in the environment although its release is live there.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNAVAILABLE: Not available in the environment for now, whatever its release's status.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BREAKING_CHANGE: Breaking change: existing integrations may need to change.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ASSISTANT: The AI assistant: chats, approvals, memories and preferences.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_DATA: Market data: prices, candles, order book, heatmaps and market overviews.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REWARDS: Rewards: daily claims, campaigns, VIP tiers and fee discounts.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADING: Orders, triggers and protective orders, and order outcomes.

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

get.description: List changes across published posts, for example every breaking change since a given time.

parameters.description: When set, only changes whose actionRequired equals this value.
parameters.name: actionRequired

parameters.description: Audiences to include; repeat the parameter for several. Empty means all. Changes addressed to ALL_USERS always match.
parameters.name: audiences

parameters.description: Categories to include; repeat the parameter for several. Empty means all.
parameters.name: categories

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on post publication time, RFC 3339; must be after startTime when both are set.
parameters.name: endTime

parameters.description: Maximum changes to return. 0 or omitted means the default of 100; maximum 500.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque, keyset-backed, exclusive cursor from a previous response. Reuse it only with the same filters, time bounds and sort. When the post it points into was republished since, paging restarts at the first change of that post's current revision, so changes of that post can appear again; match them by id.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description: Order of posts by publication time; changes keep publication order inside each post. Defaults to DESC.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on post publication time, RFC 3339.
parameters.name: startTime

parameters.description: Surfaces to include; repeat the parameter for several. Empty means all.
parameters.name: surfaces
